## Overview

The course includes three individual portfolio projects and one capstone that may be completed individually or in a team of 2–4 students. Assignment submissions and grading are managed in Canvas; the live schedule is the source of truth for due dates.

| Assignment | Work format | Course weight | Due |
|---|---|---:|---|
| [Project 1: Music Recommendation with k-NN](project1.qmd) | Individual | 10% | September 11, 2026, 11:59 p.m. ET |
| [Project 2: Neural Archaeology](project2.qmd) | Individual | 10% | October 6, 2026, 11:59 p.m. ET |
| [Project 3: Thought Cascade](thought_cascade.qmd) | Individual | 10% | November 2, 2026, 11:59 p.m. ET |
| [Capstone: Trust and Evidence in AI](capstone.qmd) | Individual or team of 2–4 | 50% | Multiple deliverables |

The separate **ML Videos for Kids** assignment is worth 3%. Participation through in-class quizzes is worth 17%.
